title: HookEvent
description: One hook invocation. Common stdin fields are lifted; the full payload travels in `payload`.

cwd.description: `cwd` from the payload: the worktree, not the original project dir.

launch_id.description:
The launch the hook came from, from the `X-Rubato-Launch` header the launched session's
hook command sends (plan 122 §D1). Keeps a launch across a `/clear` that changes the
session id. Absent for a session not launched from Rubato and from an older companion.

message_id.description:
On `UserPromptSubmit`: the session message this prompt carried, matched by the companion
because the prompt ends with the message it pasted (ADR 0051, plan 122 PR 4).

mixed.description: With `message_id`: the prompt holds text before the message (someone was typing).

payload.description: The raw hook payload, for traces and for fields this version does not lift.

truncated.description: The prompt or reply text in `payload` was cut to `Limits.session_log_max_chars`.

HookEventKind.description: Hook event names we forward. Unknown names arrive as `Unknown` and are kept, not dropped.
